must_fix.title: Past event titles are h2 siblings of the 'Past events' h2, breaking the heading outline
must_fix.evidence: events.html:51 event titles are <h2>; js/events.js moves past items under <section id=past-events> whose heading is also <h2> (events.html:155). Playwright probe on 2026-11-16 heading list: ['H2 Past events [past]', 'H2 Autumn Open Mic for Poets [past]'] — the Past events section is empty in heading navigation. Issue requires accessibility; tests/pages.test.mjs:74 only checks for skipped levels.

must_fix.title: Home page links to 'how to book' but events page never says how to book
must_fix.evidence: index.html:165 'See all events and how to book'. Five events say 'Booking required.' but give no method; `grep -niE 'to book|email|01632' events.html` only hits line 149 (cider tables) and the footer.

nits: ?genre=Nature%20writing (display name) falls back to All and drops the param; only slugs match.
Past events are listed oldest first; most recent first is more usual.
Arrow keys in the genre select push a history entry per keypress.
Contact form status keeps the stale 'Please fix the N fields' message while errors are corrected, until the next submit.
README says `npm test # node --test tests/` but the script is `node --test tests/*.test.mjs`.
Nav may briefly show the full list on narrow screens before deferred main.js adds the .js class.

report:
I wouldn't merge this yet. There are two must-fix problems, both in `events.html`. Everything else held up. **Checks I ran (all pass)** - `npm test`: 71 tests, 71 pass, 0 fail. - `npx prettier --check .`: "All matched files use Prettier code style!" - `npx eslint .`: exit code 0, no output. - At 360px, `scrollWidth` equals the viewport width (360) on all four pages, so there's no sideways scroll. - The books filter handles `?genre=NATURE-WRITING` correctly and maps it to `nature-writing` (2 of 14 books). - `git status` ends exactly as I found it. My scratch directory was outside the repo and I deleted it. **Must fix** 1. **The heading structure on the events page is wrong.** `js/events.js` moves the October 2026 event into the "Past events" section. That event's title stays an `

` (`events.html:51`), the same level as the "Past events" `

` (`events.html:155`). Screen-reader users navigating by heading will hear "Past events" as an empty section, followed by an unrelated item at the same level. A probe at today's date (2026-11-16) gave this heading list: ``` 'H2 Past events [past]', 'H2 Autumn Open Mic for Poets [past]' ``` The test in `tests/pages.test.mjs:74` only checks that heading levels never skip, so it doesn't catch this. The issue asks for an accessible site. 2. **The home page promises booking details that the events page doesn't give.** `index.html:165` links to "See all events and how to book". Five events say "Booking required", but none of them say how to book. The only contact detail on the events page is for the cider tables (`events.html:149`). Grepping `events.html` for "to book", "email" or the phone number finds only that line and the footer. A visitor can't act on "Booking required". **Nits** - A genre name like `?genre=Nature%20writing` quietly falls back to All, and the parameter is dropped from the URL. Only slugs match. - Past events are appended oldest first. Most recent first is more usual once there are several. - Each keyboard arrow press in the genre select fires `change`, which adds a new history entry each time. - After a failed submit, the form's status line ("Please fix the N fields…") stays in place while you fix fields one at a time.
